en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 9.  Imam  Musa  Kadhim  (a.s.)  said,  “One  who  recites  Surah Tauheed before meeting an unjust person, Allah will protect him from all sides and he will remain safe from the mischief of  that  unjust  person.  He  will  benefit  from  meeting  that unjust  person.
Whenever  you  develop  fear  of  something, recite  a  hundred  verses  of  the  Holy  Quran  and  say,  ‘O Allah! Take this calamity away from me’ thrice.”
